mapper.select:
SELECT a.NTT_ID, a.NTT_SJ, a.FRST_REGISTER_ID, COALESCE(b.USER_NM, a.NTCR_NM) as FRST_REGISTER_NM,
TO_CHAR(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, a.RDCNT, a.PARNTSCTT_NO, a.ANSWER_AT, a.ANSWER_LC, a.USE_AT, a.ATCH_FILE_ID, a.BBS_ID, rtrim(a.NTCE_BGNDE) NTCE_BGNDE, rtrim(a.NTCE_ENDDE) NTCE_ENDDE, a.SJ_BOLD_AT, a.NOTICE_AT, a.SECRET_AT, c.COMMENT_CO, a.NTT_EXTRA_FIELD_1, a.NTT_EXTRA_FIELD_2, a.NTT_EXTRA_FIELD_3, a.NTT_EXTRA_FIELD_4, a.NTT_EXTRA_FIELD_5, a.NTT_EXTRA_FIELD_6, a.NTT_EXTRA_FIELD_7, a.NTT_EXTRA_FIELD_8, a.NTT_EXTRA_FIELD_9, a.NTT_EXTRA_FIELD_10,
SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(SUBSTRING(a.NTT_CN, 1, 1000), '<[^>]*>|&[a-zA-Z#0-9]{2,8};', ' '), '[[:space:]]+', ' '), 1, 300) AS NTT_CN_EXCERPT FROM COMTNBBS a LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER b ON a.FRST_REGISTER_ID = b.ESNTL_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT NTT_ID, BBS_ID, COUNT(1) AS COMMENT_CO FROM COMTNCOMMENT WHERE USE_AT = 'Y' GROUP BY NTT_ID, BBS_ID) c ON a.NTT_ID = c.NTT_ID AND a.BBS_ID = c.BBS_ID WHERE a.BBS_ID = #{bbsId}
AND a.USE_AT = 'Y'
AND STRPOS(',' || a.NTT_EXTRA_FIELD_1 || ',', ',' || #{searchCategory} || ',') > 0
AND NOT ( COALESCE(LENGTH(RTRIM(a.NTCE_BGNDE)),0) = 10 AND RTRIM(a.NTCE_BGNDE) != '1900-01-01' AND RTRIM(a.NTCE_BGNDE) > #{todayYmd} ) AND NOT ( COALESCE(LENGTH(RTRIM(a.NTCE_ENDDE)),0) = 10 AND RTRIM(a.NTCE_ENDDE) != '9999-12-31' AND #{todayYmd} > RTRIM(a.NTCE_ENDDE) )
AND a.NTT_SJ LIKE '%' || #{searchWrd} || '%'
AND a.NTT_CN LIKE '%' || #{searchWrd} || '%'
AND b.USER_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchWrd} || '%'
ORDER BY a.SORT_ORDR DESC, NTT_NO ASC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}
